question:
Correctly match the following peaks of the Himalayas to their heights.

 
 

 
 
**Peak**

 
 
 
**Height in metres**

 
 
 

 
 
 
• Mt. Everest
 
 
 
 
 
• 8172
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
• Dhaulagiri
 
 
 
 
 
• 8848
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
• Kamet
 
 
 
 
 
• 8078
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
• Annapurna
 
 
 
 
 
• 7756
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - b, 2 - a, 3 - d, 4 - c.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nepal and China have officially announced **the new height of **8848.86M** of Mount Everest.
 
• **The tallest, Dhaulagiri I,** reaches an elevation of **26,795 feet** **(8,167 metres)** and is the **world's seventh highest mountain.**
 
• **Kamet was the first summit over 25,000 ft (7,620 m)** to be climbed and was** the ****highest summit reached until the first ascent of Nanda Devi five years later.**
 
• **Annapurna is the tenth highest mountain in the world** at **8,091 metres** (26,545 ft) above sea level and is well known for the difficulty and danger involved in its ascent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mount Everest is **Earth's highest mountain above sea level**, located in the** Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas.**
 
• Dhaulagiri is **the seventh highest mountain in the world at 8,167 metres (26,795 ft) above sea level, and the highest mountain within the borders of a single country (Nepal)**.
 
• **Kamet Peak** is **the highest point, and the most main passes are Shipki, Lipu Lekh (Lipulieke), and Mana**. Peaks of the **Zaskar Range from the vicinity of Sonamarg, Jammu and Kashmir union territory, India.**
 
• **Annapurna is a mountain situated in the Annapurna mountain range of Gandaki Province, north-central Nepal.**
